responsibility: Declares rs6000-specific machine modes that extend GCC’s generic mode system for this backend. It introduces the target’s IBM and IEEE 128-bit floating-point modes, specialized condition-code modes used for unsigned, floating-point, and equality-only comparisons, the full set of PowerPC vector modes used by Altivec/VSX/SPE code generation, and the PTI partial integer mode used for GPR-only 128-bit and quad-memory-atomic handling.
